trimmedBy: node trim-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by id, regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify); never a byte cut
notes: Capture had 9 jobs ("job-count"/"total-job-count" 9 retained as received); kept 6. UNCLEAR because the documented API (README + the 0-legal-notice field) grants developer access, but robots.txt (User-agent *) says "Disallow: /api/*" and "Disallow: /*category=" - the two contradict each other and the owner must decide. Terms: link back to the Remotive URL AND mention Remotive as a source or access is terminated; do not submit Remotive jobs to third-party job sites; jobs are delayed by 24 hours; at most ~4 requests/day advised, >2/minute blocked. Observed: the category=software-dev response held jobs of other categories (Marketing, Sales, Writing, IT) and the optional limit=5 parameter was ignored, so the category filter is not a reliable partition of the inventory. publication_date has NO zone designator. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
